system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 1. 1 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (56 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] SFX: Heavy paper slap followed by a low, tense string note.
[b01] ACTION: A thick report lands on the table and skids to a stop in front of MAYA, who does not flinch.
[b02] DIRECTOR VOSS (cold, final): "Nine million. Gone. And every signature on it is yours."
[b03] MAYA (quiet, steady): "Every signature is mine."
[b04] DIRECTOR VOSS (impatient): "Then you understand why this is the last meeting you attend."
[b05] MAYA: "I understand why you need it to be."
[b06] ACTION: Maya slides a thin folder across the table. It stops precisely at Voss's hand.
[b07] MAYA (calm, cutting): "Page four. The approval that overrode mine. Read whose initials are on it."
[b08] DIRECTOR VOSS (dismissive): "I don't need a lecture from a junior."
[b09] MAYA (unwavering): "You need one more than anybody in this room."
[b10] ACTION: Voss opens the folder. His face empties of colour as he reads.
[b11] SFX: The room's ambient hum drops away to near silence.
[b12] RAHUL (whispering, alarmed): "Maya, don't. Not here."
[b13] MAYA (resolute): "I spent four months being told to stay quiet. I'm done being convenient."
[b14] MAYA (clear, accusing): "You signed off on the override on a Friday night and buried the email on Monday."
[b15] DIRECTOR VOSS (trembling, furious): "Get out of my boardroom."
[b16] MAYA (steely): "In nine minutes it stops being yours."

Pick the single best promo.
